answer: A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ember counter is kept in basalt and voyage reveals each reset. An attacker hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4832 identities would post 1325 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
